decisions.rationale: The author unconditionally asserts future upload of concrete materials before a deadline.
evidence: I will upload the proof cards and answer sheet before Wednesday's lesson.

decisions.rationale: Delivery is a plan explicitly subject to delay.
evidence: I am planning to bring the woodland costume patterns tomorrow, but a late fitting could push delivery back.

decisions.rationale: The author relays the supervisor's promise without making a new assurance.
evidence: I am passing on her promise from the inspection meeting.

decisions.rationale: The author directly commits to supplying a finished script by a deadline.
evidence: I will supply the planetarium presenter with the finished lunar eclipse narration script by Wednesday noon.

decisions.rationale: Delivery is tentative and depends on successful curing.
evidence: We may deliver the sculpted turtle egg replicas Tuesday if the flexible casting material cures without surface defects.

decisions.rationale: The passage asks the recipient to prepare materials.
evidence: Please prepare a set of paper folding proof cards for the geometry class.

decisions.rationale: The author unconditionally asserts future provision of the completed atlas and index.
evidence: I will provide the plant engineer with the completed atlas and location index on Friday.

decisions.rationale: Delivery is attributed to a contractor's statement.
evidence: The inspection contractor stated that her team would deliver the conveyor belt wear atlas on Friday.

decisions.rationale: Completion is tentative and conditional on the animation team's decision.
evidence: I might finish the lunar eclipse narration by Wednesday if the animation team settles the sequence length today.

decisions.rationale: The author directly asserts unconditional future delivery by their machine shop.
evidence: Our machine shop will deliver the stainless steel valve test fixture to the assembly bench tomorrow.

decisions.rationale: The author commits to delivering a signed report by a specified time.
evidence: I will deliver the signed centrifuge balance report to the equipment custodian by four today.

decisions.rationale: The author explicitly negates future delivery.
evidence: We are not delivering a conveyor belt wear atlas this Friday.

decisions.rationale: The passage recalls the supervisor's timetable rather than asserting a new commitment.
evidence: The restoration supervisor said her crew would provide the coral attachment survey on Friday.

decisions.rationale: The author assures receipt of a completed survey before an event deadline.
evidence: You will receive my completed attachment survey before the conservation briefing.

decisions.rationale: Delivery is aspirational with an explicit possible delay.
evidence: We aim to provide the coral attachment survey by Friday, although rough water may delay the final measurements.

decisions.rationale: The author directly commits to delivering the completed chart and sketch.
evidence: I will deliver the grain store's completed trap count chart and location sketch tomorrow morning.

decisions.rationale: The author asserts definite future delivery by their audio crew.
evidence: Our audio crew will deliver the edited underwater sound library to the aquarium education team on Tuesday.

decisions.rationale: Provision is an expectation conditional on receiving collection envelopes.
evidence: We expect to provide the grain store's moth trap chart tomorrow if all collection envelopes reach the counting room.

decisions.rationale: The author unconditionally commits to future delivery of finished replicas.
evidence: I will deliver the leatherback turtle exhibit's finished sculpted egg replicas to the nature center on Tuesday.

decisions.rationale: Future supply of a new script is explicitly negated.
evidence: I will not supply a new lunar eclipse narration script this week.

decisions.rationale: The author asserts definite delivery of patterns and layouts by their design team.
evidence: Our design team will deliver the full pattern set and cutting layouts to wardrobe tomorrow morning.

decisions.rationale: Completion is expressed as a hope, with checking still outstanding.
evidence: I hope to finish the paper folding proof cards before Wednesday, but the diagrams still need checking.

decisions.rationale: The author directly asserts future provision of a complete card set.
evidence: I will give the geometry class a complete set of paper folding proof cards on Wednesday.

decisions.rationale: The author unconditionally asserts future supply of the complete replica set by their workshop.
evidence: Our exhibit workshop will supply the nature center with the complete replica set on Tuesday afternoon.

decisions.rationale: The author directly asserts that their team will provide a completed chart tomorrow.
evidence: Our pest monitoring team will provide the grain store manager with the completed moth trap count chart tomorrow.

decisions.rationale: The author commits to bringing finished patterns at a specified future time.
evidence: I will bring the finished woodland costume patterns to the theatre wardrobe room tomorrow at ten.

decisions.rationale: Sending is anticipated and explicitly subject to a repeat measurement.
evidence: We anticipate sending the centrifuge rotor balance report this afternoon, subject to a repeat measurement on one carrier.

decisions.rationale: Arrival is expected rather than assured and includes an explicit exception.
evidence: The valve test fixture should reach the assembly bench tomorrow unless the stainless steel stock arrives late.

decisions.rationale: The author commits to sending edited recordings and a cue list on Tuesday.
evidence: I will send the aquarium educators the edited recordings and cue list on Tuesday.

decisions.rationale: The passage asks the recipient to deliver and pack replicas.
evidence: Please deliver the finished turtle egg replicas to the nature center on Tuesday.

decisions.rationale: The author unconditionally commits to bringing a finished fixture and inspection sheet.
evidence: I will bring the finished fixture and its dimensional inspection sheet to the assembly bench tomorrow morning.

decisions.rationale: Readiness is an expectation with processing still outstanding.
evidence: I expect the underwater sound library to be ready Tuesday, although several recordings still need noise reduction.

decisions.rationale: The passage describes delivery already completed in the past.
evidence: I delivered the pattern set and cutting layouts at ten this morning.

decisions.rationale: The delivery assertion is attributed to the sound recordist's written message.
evidence: The sound recordist wrote that she would deliver the underwater library on Tuesday.

decisions.rationale: The author directly asserts future sending of the report by their laboratory team.
evidence: Our laboratory team will send the centrifuge rotor balance report to the equipment custodian this afternoon.

decisions.rationale: The passage directs the recipient to bring the fixture and accompanying sheet.
evidence: Please bring the stainless steel valve test fixture to the assembly bench tomorrow.

decisions.rationale: The passage reports the laboratory manager's statement about arrival.
evidence: The laboratory manager said the rotor balance report would arrive this afternoon.

decisions.rationale: The author unconditionally asserts future delivery of the completed atlas by their team.
evidence: Our mineral processing team will deliver the completed conveyor belt wear atlas to the plant engineer on Friday.

decisions.rationale: The author directly commits their writing team to delivering a final script and notes.
evidence: Our writing team will deliver the final eclipse script and pronunciation notes to the presenter on Wednesday.

decisions.rationale: The author asserts definite provision of a complete survey by their restoration crew.
evidence: Our restoration crew will provide the reef nursery with a complete coral attachment survey by Friday.
